query:
begin transaction read only;
select jsonb_build_object(
'relations',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',c.relname,'kind',c.relkind,'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'forceRls',c.relforcerowsecurity) order by n.nspname,c.relname) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where c.relkind in ('r','p') and (n.nspname in ('wordpairs','wordpairs_hosting') or (n.nspname='realtime' and c.relname='messages'))),
'policies',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',schemaname,'table',tablename,'name',policyname,'roles',roles,'cmd',cmd,'qual',qual,'check',with_check) order by schemaname,tablename,policyname) from pg_policies where schemaname in ('wordpairs','wordpairs_hosting') or (schemaname='realtime' and tablename='messages' and policyname='wordpairs_own_notifications')),
'roleFlags',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',rolname,'login',rolcanlogin,'super',rolsuper,'bypassRls',rolbypassrls) order by rolname) from pg_roles where rolname in ('anon','authenticated','service_role','wordpairs_app')),
'schemaPrivileges',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'role',r.rolname,'usage',has_schema_privilege(r.oid,n.oid,'USAGE'),'create',has_schema_privilege(r.oid,n.oid,'CREATE')) order by n.nspname,r.rolname) from pg_namespace n cross join pg_roles r where n.nspname in ('wordpairs','wordpairs_hosting','vault','net') and r.rolname in ('anon','authenticated','service_role','wordpairs_app')),
'tablePrivileges',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'table',c.relname,'role',r.rolname,'select',has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'SELECT'),'insert',has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'INSERT'),'update',has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'UPDATE'),'delete',has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'DELETE')) order by n.nspname,c.relname,r.rolname) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace cross join pg_roles r where c.relkind in ('r','p','v','m') and n.nspname in ('wordpairs','wordpairs_hosting') and r.rolname in ('anon','authenticated')),
'tickFunction',(select jsonb_build_object('owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'securityDefiner',p.prosecdef,'config',p.proconfig,'bodyMd5',md5(p.prosrc),'anonExecute',has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'authenticatedExecute',has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'serviceExecute',has_function_privilege('service_role',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'appExecute',has_function_privilege('wordpairs_app',p.oid,'EXECUTE')) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='wordpairs_hosting' and p.proname='tick'),
'cronJobs',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',jobid,'name',jobname,'schedule',schedule,'active',active,'username',username,'database',database,'expectedCommand',command='select wordpairs_hosting.tick();') order by jobid) from cron.job where jobname='wordpairs-hosted-tick'),
'scheduler',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('enabled',enabled,'endpoint',endpoint,'lastStatus',last_status,'failures',failures,'hasPendingRequest',last_request is not null,'lastSent',last_sent,'retryAfter',retry_after)) from wordpairs_hosting.scheduler),
'vaultSecretPresence',(select count(*)=1 from vault.secrets where name='wordpairs_scheduler_secret'),
'extensions',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',extname,'version',extversion) order by extname) from pg_extension where extname in ('pg_cron','pg_net')),
'sqlSessionSchemaSettingPresent',current_setting('pgrst.db_schemas',true) is not null
) as metadata;
commit;

lints.name: auth_rls_initplan
lints.title: Auth RLS Initialization Plan
lints.description: Detects if calls to \`current_setting()\` and \`auth.<function>()\` in RLS policies are being unnecessarily re-evaluated for each row

findings.detail: Table \`realtime.messages\` has a row level security policy \`wordpairs_own_notifications\` that re-evaluates current_setting() or auth.<function>() for each row. This produces suboptimal query performance at scale. Resolve the issue by replacing \`auth.<function>()\` with \`(select auth.<function>())\`. See [docs](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security#call-functions-with-select) for more info.
